title: AMA normalized semantic delta
description: Problem-A output taken as given input by AMA (docs/architecture/api-migration-direction.md §4): what changed, from what, to what. Authored from provider-side artifacts ONLY, blind to any consumer repository — a delta written after seeing consumer code has already performed part of the localization, and would make the experiment measure a task that does not exist in production. The visibility class is a HYPOTHESIS here, never a conclusion: §3 decides it empirically per (SDK, toolchain, tsconfig, code).

fact_path.description: The changed contract fact, at field/argument granularity (§2) — not the method. One method may carry several independently changed facts.

silent_failure_mode.description: What consumer code does differently while compiling cleanly and raising nothing. If this field cannot be written, the delta is probably not type-invisible and belongs to the negative control corpus (§5.1).

backward_compatible_form.description: The explicit code that preserves old behaviour, if the provider offers one.

delta_provenance.description: §6.3. Only `historical` may support an assurance claim; `synthetic` is diagnostic only.

visibility_hypothesis.description: A hypothesis to be tested by mutation per §3, recorded before testing so it cannot be retrofitted to the result.

representation.description: Which serialization was pinned. Prefer one whose bytes are reproducible: a docs site may serve an unstable HTML shell and a stable markdown variant of the same page.

digest_stability_verified.description: True only if the artifact was fetched at least twice and produced identical bytes. An unstable representation (build nonces, per-request tokens) must not be pinned: it would report STALE on every re-check and the binding would be worthless.

normative_quote.description: The exact sentence(s) the delta rests on. Rule 4: what the artifact SAYS, kept separate from any inference drawn on it.

blinding.description: §4. A delta whose blinding cannot be attested makes its case excluded, not discounted.

consumer_repositories_inspected_before_a.description: Must be empty for the blinding to hold.

inference.description: Rule 4's second level, kept explicitly apart from the artifact's own words.
